nodes.label: FORBIDDEN_SECRET_RE redaction filter
nodes.rationale: Hard-blocks outbound TTS/text containing OTP/PIN/MPIN/CVV/password (case-insensitive); the agent never speaks, stores, or transmits secrets; live KYC handled by the user directly.

nodes.label: Acoustic State Machine (RINGING/IVR/HOLD/HUMAN)

nodes.label: Dual WSS Streams (intake + assisted call)
nodes.rationale: Stream #1 citizen hi-IN intake; Stream #2 assisted-call en-IN bank audio; both via Prisma v2.5 WSS with ITN digit normalization.

nodes.label: Timbre Role-Switch Cache
nodes.rationale: Pre-warm Timbre voice contexts for fast en-IN→hi-IN switch for the citizen's post-call summary.

nodes.label: DBR.No.Leg.BC.78/2017-18 (zero liability)
nodes.rationale: Unauthorised electronic banking transaction: Zero Customer Liability if reported within 3 working days; bank shadow-credits within 10 working days.

nodes.label: Legal & Safety Badges
nodes.rationale: SIMULATED DEMO, SYNTHETIC DATA, NO AUTONOMOUS DIALING, ZERO SECRETS LEAKED, AI DISCLOSURE PLAYED badges visible throughout the video.

nodes.label: Synthetic Placeholders (demo/test)
nodes.rationale: UTR 629188340112, docket SR-DB-884120, phone +91-90000-00000, citizen Ramesh, DemoBank — real values are a challenge-rule violation and DPDP breach.

nodes.label: DPDP Act 2023 (data protection)
nodes.rationale: Consent must be free, specific, informed, unconditional, unambiguous, and timestamped before voice processing; data minimization: no Aadhaar/PAN/OTP/PIN/CVV/password collected.

nodes.label: FastAPI + asyncio Orchestrator
nodes.rationale: Free, single-process, deployable on any free tier; WebSocket (Prisma) + SSE (Timbre) map naturally; easy for AI agents to read.

nodes.label: Gnani Evon v3.3 (LLM)
nodes.rationale: Apache-2.0 open weights kept on Indian infrastructure; 302 ms TTFT at 257 tok/s via vLLM/SGLang on spot GPU with prefix-cached system prompt and short JSON schema (<45 tok).

nodes.label: Gnani Prisma v2.5 (STT)
nodes.rationale: Chosen over OpenAI Realtime for the native 8 kHz Indian telephony ITN contract (UTR/lakhs/crores normalization) and sub-200 ms partials; covered by free credits; Whisper kept only as a local benchmark baseline.

nodes.label: Gnani Sovereign Stack
nodes.rationale: Prisma v2.5 + Evon v3.3 + Timbre v2.5/v3.0 on 5,000 free Gnani credits; no OpenAI/Anthropic/Google production models; fallback to local open-source models if credits exhaust.

nodes.label: Gnani Timbre v2.5/v3.0 (TTS)
nodes.rationale: Native bilingual hi-IN↔en-IN switching with <100–200 ms TTFA; role-switch caching used for the post-call summary.

nodes.label: Great Indian AI Internship Challenge (Gnani AI)
nodes.norm_label: great indian ai internship challenge (gnani ai)

nodes.label: AI Disclosure Gate (ai_disclosure_played)
nodes.rationale: Any AI-assisted communication must state 'This is an AI assistant assisting [user name]' and never impersonate the user; script is given to the user to read by default.

nodes.label: Verbatim Substring Docket Verification
nodes.rationale: Docket/SR ID must be an exact case-insensitive substring of the verbatim call transcript; result recorded in HaqVaaniCaseRecord.verbatim_verified.

nodes.label: Hugging Face Spaces Deployment
nodes.rationale: Primary deployment target: no credit card, 16 GB RAM, Docker blank template exposes a raw WebSocket port; pre-warm health endpoint every 10 min before demo to prevent sleep.

nodes.label: Human-Controlled Refund Advocate
nodes.rationale: The citizen remains the caller and decision-maker; HaqVaani never autonomously dials the bank (avoids TRAI A2P compliance, identity/fraud, and impersonation risk) — it listens, computes RBI rules, organizes evidence, and supplies a complaint trail.

nodes.label: 690 ms Post-VAD Latency Budget
nodes.rationale: Voice intake budget: DSP+VAD 36 ms + Prisma final 168 ms + Evon JSON 302 ms + Timbre first audio 184 ms = 690 ms, with 210 ms headroom under the 900 ms hard ceiling.

nodes.label: RB-IOS 2026 (Ombudsman Scheme)
nodes.rationale: Notified 16 Jan 2026, in force 1 Jul 2026; Clause 3 authorised non-advocate representation; award ceilings ₹30 lakh consequential loss / ₹3 lakh time-loss & harassment; 30-day bank resolution then 90-day filing window on cms.rbi.org.in or 14448.

nodes.label: RB-IOS 2026 Clause 3 Authorised Representation
nodes.rationale: A complainant may use an authorised representative other than an advocate; HaqVaani positions itself as the citizen's AI-assisted support tool under this clause.

nodes.label: RBI/2019-20/67 Circular (failed UPI)
nodes.rationale: Failed UPI P2P/IMPS TAT = T+1; P2M/ATM/PoS TAT = T+5; ₹100/day compensation beyond TAT, paid suo motu; circular dated 20 Sep 2019.

nodes.label: RBI Ombudsman (cms.rbi.org.in)
nodes.rationale: HaqVaani does not replace the Ombudsman; it prepares the citizen — first a formal grievance to the Regulated Entity, then RB-IOS 2026 CMS filing after the 30-day window.

nodes.label: Silero VAD + DSP
nodes.rationale: Zero-cost local CPU VAD (220 ms hangover) with 200 ms/60 ms ring buffer for voice intake and assisted-call listening.

nodes.label: Simulated 60s Demo Day Drop Video
nodes.rationale: 100% real Gnani API execution over real PCM, simulated bank IVR + pre-recorded synthetic audio, zero real outbound calls, 16:9 master + 9:16 cut with burned captions and legal badges.

nodes.label: SQLite / No-DB Storage
nodes.rationale: MVP is stateless per case; prefer no database, add file-based SQLite only if case records need persistence; avoids managed Postgres/Redis cost and ops.

nodes.label: 30-Clip Prisma vs Whisper Benchmark
nodes.rationale: 30 synthetic noisy UTR/Hinglish clips at 8 kHz; per-clip WER plus p50/p95 latency, genuinely measured and displayed on the HUD — never hardcoded estimates.

nodes.label: TRAI 2026 A2P Calling Rules
nodes.rationale: A2P callers must pre-declare CLI details to the telecom provider; undeclared automated calls risk UCC classification; HaqVaani v1 makes no A2P calls — the user dials the bank.

nodes.label: Sloplint UI Audit Gate
nodes.rationale: Automated frontend QA gate that renders 5 screenshot sizes and groups findings by gate (FAIL/REFLEX/WARN); enforces design-system quality on landing.html and the CSS token system.

nodes.label: Latency Optimization Playbook
nodes.rationale: Levers: 160–200 ms chunk cadence, vLLM prefix cache + short schema, TTS pre-warm of statutory clause prefixes, pre-allocated NumPy ring buffer, role-switch cache; ceiling rule = optimize if any stage exceeds budget for 3+ consecutive clips.

nodes.label: Free Method Per Component
nodes.rationale: Every component chosen to satisfy the zero-paid-infrastructure constraint: Gnani free 5,000 credits, open-source tools, and free GPU (Kaggle/Colab).

nodes.label: Authentication Recommendation (minimal consent)
nodes.rationale: No OAuth/password auth: demo tool, not consumer app; plain-language consent screen sets citizen_consent_verified timestamped in ConsentRecord per DPDP Act 2023; Gnani API key is the only secret.

nodes.label: Single-File Frontend Recommendation
nodes.rationale: Vanilla JS + Canvas + Tailwind CDN: zero build step, zero deps, previewable anywhere, one file cropped to 16:9 and 9:16; React/Vite and Streamlit rejected.

nodes.label: FORBIDDEN_SECRET_RE — outbound secret redaction
nodes.rationale: Structurally blocks OTP/PIN/MPIN/CVV/password from any outbound TTS/text.
